neighbours.label: the verb or preposition inside a concessive or counterfactual clause (Although ... rarely used to treat, Had he lived in), as against the same content stated as plain fact
fire: Although surgery is seldom used to correct this defect, it can work.
Had he stayed in Paris, he might have become a painter.
Even though the bridge was built to carry trains, it now serves cyclists.
Had they arrived on time, they would have caught the ferry.
Although the drug was designed to lower fever, it also eases pain.
Were she to move to Rome, she would study architecture.
Though the law was meant to protect tenants, landlords exploited it.
Had the storm reached the coast, the harbor would have flooded.
quiet: Surgery is often used to correct this defect, and it works.
He stayed in Paris and became a painter.
The bridge carries trains and cyclists every day.
They arrived on time and caught the ferry.
The drug lowers fever and eases pain.
She moved to Rome and studied architecture.
The law protects tenants from unfair eviction.
The storm reached the coast and flooded the harbor.
